preconditions.description: The number of initial cards n is between 2 and 100 inclusive.
The final remaining card value d has an absolute value at most 10000.
The limit l for initial card values is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(d, int) and isinstance(l, int)
preconditions.description: The inputs n, d, and l are integers.

postconditions.expression: if not exists_valid_sequence(n, d, l): stdout == '-1\n' else (len(output_sequence) == n and all(1 <= x <= l for x in output_sequence) and compute_final_value(output_sequence) == d)
postconditions.description: If no valid sequence exists, output -1. Otherwise, output a sequence of n integers where each is between 1 and l, and the result of the reduction process equals d.

postconditions.expression: exists_valid_sequence(n, d, l) == (any(all(1 <= x <= l for x in seq) and compute_final_value(seq) == d for seq in all_possible_sequences(n, l)))
postconditions.description: A valid sequence exists if and only if there is at least one sequence of n integers in [1, l] that reduces to d.
